output.summary: KEP-647 proposes adding OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing to the Kubernetes API Server, exporting spans in OpenTelemetry format for incoming and outgoing requests and propagating context. Status is implemented, stage stable (implemented from 2025-07-31).
output.rationale: The API Server's existing tracing (k8s.io/utils/trace) is described as a "poor-man's form of tracing", and distributed tracing is proposed to improve ease of use and analysis. Context propagation lets plugins such as admission webhooks add to API Server requests. Controller-side context propagation via object fields/annotations was removed from scope because it was "large and controversial", leaving the API Server request tracing as the agreed portion.

alternatives.option: Store trace context in object metadata (a field) for controller propagation
alternatives.why_not: Reviewers objected to unlimited lifespan, linearization of controller actions, and half-mandatory use; the author removed it: "I decided that having controllers update this field is more trouble than it is worth, and removed this."

alternatives.option: Use an annotation to carry trace context on objects, with controllers updating it
alternatives.why_not: Discussed as option 4/5 in the thread; the author judged controller updates costly ("an extra write, which we would like to avoid") and deferred the idea rather than adopting it in this KEP.

alternatives.option: Record causal 'why' tuples outside objects and build graphs offline (lavalamp's proposal)
alternatives.why_not: Source says the author and reviewer did not converge: lavalamp said "I can't in good faith say 'yes' to something including the rest of this proposal" and asked for the API request tracing part to be split out; the sources do not record this alternative being adopted.

alternatives.option: Run tracing exporter with a dedicated OpenTelemetry egress type for the master
alternatives.why_not: Source says the author suggested starting with the Master egress type and possibly delaying service-based config: "we may want to delay this until after the initial implementation to gather feedback"; the final choice of egress configuration beyond file-based config is not stated.

evidence.quote: The API Server currently uses a poor-man's form of tracing (see github.com/kubernetes/utils/trace), but we can make use of distributed tracing to improve the ease of use
the scope was large and controversial enough to make it difficult to drive consensus. At this point, i'm just trying to make some progress.
I can't in good faith say "yes" to something including the rest of this proposal, since I don't think it's theoretically sound.
I decided that having controllers update this field is more trouble than it is worth, and removed this.
I specified that if the configuration file path isn't specified, tracing is disabled.
